description: One simulated student in a math-teacher class, for same-machine testing: watches its assigned question (tiered if the teacher's adaptive difficulty is on) and answers after a short random 'thinking' delay. A REAL student doesn't install this -- they join a live class by code from math-teacher's own UI, which answers all four question types (multiple choice, free response, multi-select, matching-pair by click or drag-and-drop) for real. Install several instances of this bot to populate math-teacher's live tally for testing without real students.
author: prackoreal
